profile: Mac Companion local XPC Interactive role-data transport v0.1
rules: same-team exact-role authentication and accepted menu readiness are required before role-data traffic
input and media use independent single-flight lanes and may overlap lease lifecycle traffic without widening its authority
the Agent sends only a strict canonical InteractiveInputEnvelope and the menu derives the current complete lease fence inside its serialized runtime owner
the menu samples its local monotonic clock immediately before input runtime admission and success means the exact input action was accepted
media carries one separately typed 96-byte header and its exact payload; the Agent validates both before transferring the record to the exact authenticated role-pair owner
media success is withheld until the Agent role-data source accepts the complete record, so the menu retains at most one publication in flight
input payloads are at most 65536 bytes and media payloads are at most 8388608 bytes with record-specific bounds enforced by the decoded header
every request rechecks the retained peer, transport generation, readiness, authorization method, and private endpoint token or exact inbound generation immediately before admission
there is no handled application-error envelope and neither direction retries after ambiguous delivery
rejection, timeout, cancellation after send, malformed traffic, wrong kind, cross-fence data, overlap on one lane, or generation loss terminates the exact authenticated generation
role-data traffic cannot create, replace, renew, revoke, or broaden an Interactive lease and carries no credential, route, private key, arbitrary file, shell command, clipboard, or audio

explicit authenticated role-pump retirement discharges and discards only its exact session/epoch media publications; late retired records are acknowledged as disposed without crossing into a replacement role pair; unknown mismatches still fail closed and menu generation invalidation clears the bounded history
